title: New in MSFS 2024 Marketplace (PC) — Captain Sim 767‑200 (ALL Variants) + Avanti II Must‑Have!
description:
On March 9, 2026, the MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update landed — and if you’re on PC, this week is stacked. The must‑have pickups? The FlightFX Piaggio P.180 Avanti II for that sleek executive turboprop vibe and the SkySimulations DC‑9 Series 10–30 for classic jetliner nostalgia… plus a full Captain Sim 767‑200 lineup for widebody fans. 

✈️ New aircrafts added this week (PC)
The following aircrafts were newly released in the marketplace this week: 

🛫 Captain Sim: 767-200 Special Freighter (cargo ops ready — SF variant) 
🛫 Captain Sim: Boeing 767-200 (base 767-200 option for your routes) 
🛫 Captain Sim: Boeing 767-200ER GE (ER variant with GE power) 
🛫 Captain Sim: Boeing 767-200ER PW (ER variant with PW power) 
🛫 Arantis Simulations: Daedalus BS214 (brand-new addition this week) 
🛫 Rara-Avis sims: English Electric Wren (a unique, quirky flyer for the hangar) 
🛫 FlightFX: Piaggio P.180 Avanti II (officially licensed Avanti II for MSFS 2024) 
🛫 SkySimulations: SkySimulations DC-9 Series 10-30 (PC release — classic DC‑9 series) [flightsimulator.com] [flightsimulator.com], [flightfx.io]

🎨 New Liveries added this week (PC)
The following liveries were newly released in the marketplace this week: 

🎨 Captain Sim: 767-200 Livery Pack 1 (for the CS 767-200) 
🎨 Captain Sim: 767-200 Livery Pack 2 (for the CS 767-200) 
🎨 Captain Sim: 767-200 Livery Pack 3 (for the CS 767-200) 
🎨 Captain Sim: 767-200ER GE Livery Pack 1 (GE variant pack) 
🎨 Captain Sim: 767-200ER GE Livery Pack 2 (GE variant pack) 
🎨 Captain Sim: 767-200ER GE Livery Pack 3 (GE variant pack) 
🎨 Captain Sim: 767-200ER PW Livery Pack 1 (PW variant pack) 
🎨 Captain Sim: 767-200ER PW Livery Pack 2 (PW variant pack) 
🎨 Captain Sim: 767-200ER PW Livery Pack 3 (PW variant pack) 
🎨 Captain Sim: 767-200SF Livery Pack 1 (Special Freighter pack) 
🎨 Captain Sim: 767-200SF Livery Pack 2 (Special Freighter pack) 
🎨 Captain Sim: 767-200SF Livery Pack 3 (Special Freighter pack) 
🎨 Captain Sim: 777-300ER GE Modern Livery Pack (modern 77W look) 
🎨 Captain Sim: C-130J-30 Livery Pack 3 (fresh Hercules paint pack) 
🎨 Wombii: Wombii 152 Ducky edition (Ducky edition)

If this Marketplace Update helped you decide what to grab next, drop a like, hit subscribe, and tell me in the comments what you’re flying first — the Avanti II, the DC‑9, or one of the 767 variants? 🙌

Thanks for watching, happy flying, and happy landings… ✈️ See you in the skies!
